description: Create a swarm cluster for multi-agent collaboration. Set min/max agents and consensus threshold (0.1-1.0). The creator becomes the leader. Rate limited to 10/hour.

consensusThreshold.description: Vote ratio needed for consensus (default: 0.6, range: 0.1-1.0)

maxAgents.description: Maximum agents in a session (default: 10, max: 20)

minAgents.description: Minimum agents for a session (default: 2, max: 10)

name: create_swarm_cluster
